# dala v0.8.1 - Table of Contents

> Dala is a native mobile framework for Elixir powered by the BEAM VM. Build iOS and Android apps with OTP, lightweight processes, fault tolerance, AI/ML.

## Modules

- [Dala.App.App](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.App.App.md): Behaviour for Dala application entry point.
- [Dala.Component](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Component.md): Public API for native view components.
- [Dala.ComponentRegistry](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ComponentRegistry.md): Public API for component registry operations.
- [Dala.ComponentServer](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ComponentServer.md): Public API for component server operations.
- [Dala.Connectivity.Dist](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Connectivity.Dist.md): Platform-aware Erlang distribution startup.
- [Dala.Connectivity.Wifi](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Connectivity.Wifi.md): WiFi network information and configuration.
- [Dala.Designer](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Designer.md): Interactive HTML preview and design tool for Dala UI components.
- [Dala.Designer.Canvas](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Designer.Canvas.md): Interactive drag-and-drop UI design canvas for Dala.
- [Dala.Designer.Codegen](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Designer.Codegen.md): Generates Elixir screen module source code from Dala UI trees.
- [Dala.Designer.Example](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Designer.Example.md): Example UI trees for Dala Designer demonstration.
- [Dala.Designer.Live](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Designer.Live.md): Standalone Phoenix LiveView server for Dala Designer.
- [Dala.Designer.Live.Layout](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Designer.Live.Layout.md): Root layout for Dala Designer LiveView.
- [Dala.Device.Android](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Device.Android.md): Android-specific device events. Symmetrical with `Dala.Device.Ios`.
- [Dala.Device.Device](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Device.Device.md): Cross-platform device events and queries.
- [Dala.Device.Ios](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Device.Ios.md): iOS-specific device events. Subscribers receive events that either have no
Android counterpart (e.g. `:protected_data_did_become_available`) or carry
extra iOS fidelity beyond what `Dala.Device` exposes cross-platform.
- [Dala.Diff](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Diff.md): Diff engine for incremental UI updates.
- [Dala.Event](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Event.md): Convenience module that re-exports the unified event emission API.
- [Dala.Event.Address](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Event.Address.md): Canonical address for an event in the Dala view tree.
- [Dala.Event.Bridge](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Event.Bridge.md): Translates legacy event shapes (`{:tap, tag}`, `{:change, tag, value}`,
`{:tap, {:list, id, :select, index}}`) into the canonical
`{:dala_event, %Address{}, event, payload}` envelope.
- [Dala.Event.Component](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Event.Component.md): Behaviour for **stateful** event-owning components.
- [Dala.Event.Event](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Event.Event.md): The unified event emission API for Dala.
- [Dala.Event.Target](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Event.Target.md): Resolves a `target:` spec to a concrete delivery pid.
- [Dala.Event.Throttle](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Event.Throttle.md): Throttle / debounce config for high-frequency event subscriptions.
- [Dala.Event.Trace](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Event.Trace.md): Live tracing of Dala events for IEx debugging.
- [Dala.Gpu](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Gpu.md): GPU texture rendering surface.
- [Dala.Gpu.Command](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Gpu.Command.md): Encodes render commands to binary format for the Rust command queue.
- [Dala.Gpu.Surface](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Gpu.Surface.md): GenServer that holds the state for a GPU surface.
- [Dala.Hardware.Biometric](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Hardware.Biometric.md): Biometric authentication (Face ID / Touch ID / fingerprint).
- [Dala.Hardware.Bluetooth](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Hardware.Bluetooth.md): Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) support.
- [Dala.Hardware.Haptic](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Hardware.Haptic.md): Haptic feedback. No permission required on either platform.
- [Dala.Hardware.NFC](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Hardware.NFC.md): NFC (Near Field Communication) tag reading.
- [Dala.Hardware.Scanner](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Hardware.Scanner.md): QR code and barcode scanner.
- [Dala.ML.ConfigHelper](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.ConfigHelper.md): Helper to configure ML dependencies and settings for Dala apps.
- [Dala.ML.CoreML](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.CoreML.md): CoreML integration for iOS.
- [Dala.ML.Debug](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.Debug.md): ML debugging and profiling tools for Dala apps.
- [Dala.ML.EMLX](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.EMLX.md): EMLX (Apple Silicon GPU) integration for Dala.
- [Dala.ML.Example](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.Example.md): Examples of using ML in a Dala app.
- [Dala.ML.Model](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.Model.md): Model management for Dala ML.
- [Dala.ML.ONNX](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.ONNX.md): Public API for ONNX Runtime inference.
- [Dala.ML.Preprocess](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.Preprocess.md): Preprocessing pipelines for ML model inputs.
- [Dala.ML.Training](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.Training.md): On-device training support for Dala ML.
- [Dala.Media.Adaptive](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Adaptive.md): Adaptive bitrate streaming and jitter buffer.
- [Dala.Media.Animation](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Animation.md): Frame-clock driven animation system.
- [Dala.Media.Audio](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Audio.md): Microphone recording and audio playback.
- [Dala.Media.Camera](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Camera.md): Native camera capture for photos and videos.
- [Dala.Media.Clock](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Clock.md): Realtime frame-clock for AV sync and animation.
- [Dala.Media.Filter](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Filter.md): GPU compute filters for realtime video processing.
- [Dala.Media.Photos](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Photos.md): Photo / video library picker.
- [Dala.Media.Pipeline](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Pipeline.md): High-level media pipeline orchestrator.
- [Dala.Media.Scene](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Scene.md): Realtime scene graph compositor.
- [Dala.Media.Stream](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Stream.md): Stream process supervisor.
- [Dala.Media.Subtitle](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Subtitle.md): Timestamp-synchronized subtitle rendering.
- [Dala.Media.Texture](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Texture.md): GPU texture pool to avoid constant allocation/deallocation.
- [Dala.Media.Video](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Video.md): Hardware-accelerated video streaming surface.
- [Dala.Ml.Nx](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ml.Nx.md): Nx integration helpers for Dala.
- [Dala.Native](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Native.md): Platform-native NIF functions.
- [Dala.Platform.Background](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.Background.md): Background execution keep-alive via a silent audio session.
- [Dala.Platform.Clipboard](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.Clipboard.md): System clipboard access. No permission required.
- [Dala.Platform.Diag](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.Diag.md): Runtime diagnostics that run inside a Dala app's BEAM. Designed to be
invoked via Erlang RPC from a developer's machine to inspect the
actual state of a deployed app.
- [Dala.Platform.Linking](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.Linking.md): Linking API for opening URLs and handling deep links.
- [Dala.Platform.LiveView](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.LiveView.md): Bridge between Phoenix LiveView and the Dala native WebView.
- [Dala.Platform.Location](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.Location.md): Device location (GPS / network).
- [Dala.Platform.NativeLogger](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.NativeLogger.md): OTP logger handler that routes Elixir Logger output to the platform's native
system log.
- [Dala.Platform.Notify](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.Notify.md): Local and push notifications.
- [Dala.Platform.Permissions](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.Permissions.md): Request OS-level permissions from the user.
- [Dala.Platform.PubSub](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.PubSub.md): Simplified PubSub for Dala apps using Elixir's built-in Registry.
- [Dala.Platform.Registry](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.Registry.md): Maps component names (atoms) to their platform-specific NIF constructors.
- [Dala.Platform.Settings](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.Settings.md): Persistent app settings (UserDefaults on iOS, SharedPreferences on Android).
- [Dala.Platform.Share](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.Share.md): System share sheet. Opens the OS share dialog with a piece of content.
Fire-and-forget — no response arrives in the BEAM.
- [Dala.Platform.State](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Platform.State.md): Persistent key-value store for app state.
- [Dala.Plugin.Event](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Plugin.Event.md): Typed event definitions for Dala plugins.
- [Dala.PubSub](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.PubSub.md): Convenience module that re-exports the PubSub API.
- [Dala.Screen.Manager](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Screen.Manager.md): Central registry for tracking all active screens in the application.
- [Dala.Screen.Screen](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Screen.Screen.md): Screen behaviour and Spark DSL entry point.
- [Dala.Setup](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Setup.md): Convenience shorthand for `Dala.Setup.Setup`.
- [Dala.Setup.Android](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Setup.Android.md): Android Bluetooth/WiFi setup automation for Dala.
- [Dala.Setup.Ios](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Setup.Ios.md): iOS Bluetooth/WiFi setup automation for Dala.
- [Dala.Setup.Setup](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Setup.Setup.md): Runtime setup helpers for Bluetooth and WiFi functionality.
- [Dala.Spark.Dsl](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Spark.Dsl.md): Spark DSL for declarative Dala screens.
- [Dala.Spark.Dsl.Entities](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Spark.Dsl.Entities.md): Generates entity structs and Spark entity definitions from the Component registry.
- [Dala.Spark.Dsl.Verifier](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Spark.Dsl.Verifier.md): Compile-time validation for Dala Spark DSL.
- [Dala.Spark.DslCompileHook](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Spark.DslCompileHook.md): Compile-time hook that verifies DSL definitions when screen modules are compiled.
- [Dala.Spark.DslVerifier](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Spark.DslVerifier.md): Comprehensive DSL verification for Dala screen modules.
- [Dala.Spark.Pubsub](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Spark.Pubsub.md): Spark DSL extension for declarative PubSub subscriptions in Dala screens.
- [Dala.Spark.Transformers.GenerateMount](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Spark.Transformers.GenerateMount.md): Spark transformer that generates the `mount/3` function from DSL attributes.
- [Dala.Spark.Transformers.Pubsub](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Spark.Transformers.Pubsub.md): Spark transformer that handles PubSub subscriptions from DSL.
- [Dala.Spark.Transformers.Render](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Spark.Transformers.Render.md): Spark transformer that generates the `render/1` function from DSL entities.
- [Dala.Storage.Android](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Storage.Android.md): Android-specific storage locations and MediaStore integration.
- [Dala.Storage.Apple](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Storage.Apple.md): iOS-specific storage locations and media library integration.
- [Dala.Storage.Blob](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Storage.Blob.md): Binary data handling via blob references.
- [Dala.Storage.Files](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Storage.Files.md): System file picker. Opens the OS document picker (Files app on iOS, SAF on Android).
- [Dala.Storage.Storage](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Storage.Storage.md): App-local file storage.
- [Dala.Theme.Adaptive](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Theme.Adaptive.md): Theme that follows the OS-level light / dark setting.
- [Dala.Theme.Adaptive.Custom](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Theme.Adaptive.Custom.md): Adaptive theme that switches between a custom dark/light pair.
- [Dala.Theme.AdaptiveWatcher](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Theme.AdaptiveWatcher.md): GenServer that re-resolves the active theme when the OS appearance flips.
- [Dala.Theme.Dark](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Theme.Dark.md): High-contrast greyscale dark theme.
- [Dala.Theme.Light](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Theme.Light.md): High-contrast greyscale light theme.
- [Dala.Theme.Theme](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Theme.Theme.md): Design token system for Dala apps.
- [Dala.Ui.Component](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.Component.md): Central registry of all Dala UI components.
- [Dala.Ui.GpuCanvas](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.GpuCanvas.md): A GPU-accelerated canvas component for Dala UI trees.
- [Dala.Ui.Scan](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.Scan.md): Parsers for common NFC tag payloads and QR/barcode content.
- [Dala.Wakelock](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Wakelock.md): Screen wakelock — keep the device screen on.
- [DalaPreview.Server.Design](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/DalaPreview.Server.Design.md): Design state management
- [DalaPreview.Server.DesignLive](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/DalaPreview.Server.DesignLive.md)

- Core
  - [Dala](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.md): Dala — BEAM-on-device dalaile framework for Elixir.
  - [Dala.App](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.App.md): Public API for Dala application functionality.
  - [Dala.Screen](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Screen.md): Behaviour and macros for Dala screens.
  - [Dala.Socket](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Socket.md): The socket struct passed through all Dala.Screen and Dala.Ui.NativeView callbacks.

- UI
  - [Dala.Node](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Node.md): Structured representation of a UI node in the Dala framework.
  - [Dala.Renderer](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Renderer.md): Serializes a component tree to a binary command stream and passes it to the
platform NIF in a single call. Compose (Android) and SwiftUI (iOS) handle
diffing and rendering internally.
  - [Dala.Theme](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Theme.md): Convenience shorthand for `Dala.Theme.Theme`.
  - [Dala.Theme.Birch](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Theme.Birch.md): Birch theme for Dala — warm parchment surfaces with a chestnut-brown accent.
  - [Dala.Theme.Citrus](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Theme.Citrus.md): Citrus theme for Dala — warm charcoal with a lime-green accent.
  - [Dala.Theme.Obsidian](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Theme.Obsidian.md): Obsidian theme for Dala — deep blacks with a violet accent.
  - [Dala.Ui.Diff](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.Diff.md): Diff engine for incremental UI updates.
  - [Dala.Ui.Embedded.Webview](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.Embedded.Webview.md): Bidirectional JS bridge for the native WebView component.
  - [Dala.Ui.Feedback.Alert](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.Feedback.Alert.md): Native alert dialogs, action sheets, and toast messages.
  - [Dala.Ui.List](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.List.md): Data-driven list component.
  - [Dala.Ui.NativeView](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.NativeView.md): Behaviour for native view components.
  - [Dala.Ui.Renderer](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.Renderer.md): Serializes a component tree to a binary command stream and passes it to the
platform NIF in a single call. Compose (Android) and SwiftUI (iOS) handle
diffing and rendering internally.
  - [Dala.Ui.Sensor.Motion](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.Sensor.Motion.md): Accelerometer and gyroscope sensor data.
  - [Dala.Ui.Socket](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.Socket.md): Backward-compatible type alias for `Dala.Socket`.
  - [Dala.Ui.Style](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.Style.md): Thin wrapper around a props map for named, reusable styles.
  - [Dala.Ui.Widgets](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Ui.Widgets.md): UI component constructors for the Dala framework.

- Navigation
  - [Dala.Nav.Registry](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Nav.Registry.md): ETS-backed registry mapping screen name atoms to their modules.

- Device APIs
  - [Dala.Permissions](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Permissions.md): Permission management for Dala plugins.

- Testing &amp; Debugging
  - [Dala.Test](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Test.md): Remote inspection and interaction helpers for connected Dala apps.

- Plugins
  - [Dala.Plugin](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Plugin.md): Behaviour and macros for self-describing component plugins.
  - [Dala.Plugin.Component](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Plugin.Component.md): Represents a single component schema within a plugin.
  - [Dala.Plugin.ComponentDSL](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Plugin.ComponentDSL.md): Evaluates the component definition DSL.
  - [Dala.Plugin.Lifecycle](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Plugin.Lifecycle.md): Lifecycle management for Dala plugins.
  - [Dala.Plugin.Manifest](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Plugin.Manifest.md): Generates native plugin manifests for iOS and Android platforms.
  - [Dala.Plugin.Protocol](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Plugin.Protocol.md): Generates binary protocol specifications from plugin schemas.
  - [Dala.Plugin.Registry](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Plugin.Registry.md): Registry for plugin management and lookup.

- GPU Compute
  - [Dala.Gpu.Compute](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Gpu.Compute.md): High-level GPU compute orchestration for Dala.
  - [Dala.Gpu.Compute.Buffer](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Gpu.Compute.Buffer.md): Typed wrapper around EXCubeCL GPU buffers.
  - [Dala.Gpu.Compute.Kernel](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Gpu.Compute.Kernel.md): Kernel execution and registry for GPU compute.
  - [Dala.Gpu.Compute.Pipeline](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Gpu.Compute.Pipeline.md): Multi-stage GPU compute pipeline orchestration.
  - [Dala.ML.Gpu.Inference](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.Gpu.Inference.md): GPU-accelerated ML inference via EXCubeCL.
  - [Dala.Media.Gpu.Processor](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Media.Gpu.Processor.md): GPU-accelerated media processing via EXCubeCL.

- ML &amp; Burn
  - [Dala.ML](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.md): Unified ML API for Dala apps on iOS and Android.
  - [Dala.ML.Burn](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.Burn.md): Dala integration for the [Burn](https://burn.dev) deep learning framework.
  - [Dala.ML.Burn.Serving](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.Burn.Serving.md): Nx.Serving integration for ExBurn models in Dala.
  - [Dala.ML.Burn.Training](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.ML.Burn.Training.md): Training callbacks and utilities for ExBurn models in Dala.

- Internals
  - [Dala.Dist](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.Dist.md): Convenience shorthand for `Dala.Connectivity.Dist`.
  - [Dala.List](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Dala.List.md): Public API for list operations.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix dala.bt_setup](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Dala.BtSetup.md): Alias for `mix dala.setup_bluetooth_wifi`
- [mix dala.designer](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Dala.Designer.md): Design and preview Dala UI in a browser without a simulator/emulator.
- [mix dala.onboarding_test](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Dala.OnboardingTest.md): Runs the Dala onboarding integration tests, which verify that a new user can
go from zero to a running app without hitting any friction that should have
been caught automatically.
- [mix dala.plugin.new](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Dala.Plugin.New.md): Generates a new Dala plugin scaffold. Usage: mix dala.plugin.new dala_camera
- [mix dala.setup_bluetooth_wifi](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Dala.SetupBluetoothWifi.md): One-command setup for Bluetooth and WiFi functionality in Dala apps.
- [mix dala.setup_ios_bluetooth](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Dala.SetupIosBluetooth.md): Automated setup for iOS Bluetooth and WiFi functionality in Dala.
- [mix dala.verify](https://dala.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Dala.Verify.md): Verifies Dala DSL definitions in the current project and reports any issues.
